results.text: Transport and thiazide-inhibition mechanisms of the Na-Cl cotransporter: a structural perspective. The structures of the human sodium-chloride cotransporter (hNCC) and its complex with thiazide diuretics have been determined recently. This review summarizes key structural insights into NCC's transport and inhibition mechanisms.
